blueprints.title: 丰川祥子 · 观众席上的乐团起点
blueprints.description: 祥子穿整齐校服坐在学校礼堂第一排侧边的观众椅上，膝上放着折好的节目单。她双手轻压节目单，抬起金黄色眼睛注视画面外的舞台；一束柔和侧光照亮微微扬起的嘴角，前后相邻的空座椅明确表现她是听众。

blueprints.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa listens from a padded audience chair in the side section of the school auditorium. Her navy school blazer and ribbon-tied blue hair catch a gentle side spotlight as a small inspired smile develops. The close seated composition includes adjacent empty audience chairs in front and behind her. All of her attention goes to listening, with her hands visibly resting on the program.
